content.text: The Notification System is responsible for providing real-time updates to customers, delivery partners, and merchants. It ensures that all stakeholders are informed of critical events throughout the order lifecycle, from placement to completion.
: The system must send automated notifications for key events:

- Order Confirmation (to Customer)
    - Order Ready for Pickup (to Delivery Partner)
    - Order Picked Up (to Customer)
    - Delivery Arriving Soon (to Customer)
    - Order Delivered (to Customer and Merchant)
: Support for WhatsApp (Primary), Push Notifications (Mobile App), SMS (Emergency/Offline), and In-app Message Center.
: If WhatsApp delivery fails, the system must automatically attempt delivery via Push Notification, then SMS.
: All notification content will be provided in English only for the initial release.
: Users must be able to toggle specific notification types.

: Transactional updates (Order Status) are mandatory and cannot be disabled.
    -
: Promotional/Ad notifications can be toggled off by the user.
: Specific alerts for new available orders based on proximity.
: Proximity checks will occur when the app is in the foreground or active "On Duty" mode, respecting "Only while using the app" OS permissions.
: Ability to send promotional/ad-based notifications to users without requiring "read" status tracking.
: Push notifications should be delivered within 5 seconds of the triggering event.
: The system must guarantee at least once delivery for transactional notifications.
: Clients must use idempotency keys to handle and de-duplicate notifications resulting from "at least once" delivery.
: Ability to handle a high volume of concurrent notifications during peak hours (e.g., lunch and dinner).
: Transactional alerts must be processed in a high-priority queue, separate from promotional notifications.

comments.text: at least once delivery for transactional notifications

The document lacks a strategy for handling duplicate notifications that may arise from 'at least once' delivery. Suggest defining idempotency keys for the client-side to prevent users from receiving the same alert multiple times.
Support for WhatsApp (Primary), Push Notifications (Mobile App), SMS (Emergency/Offline)

There is no mention of a fallback mechanism. If the primary channel (WhatsApp) fails to deliver, the system should automatically attempt delivery via SMS or Push. Recommend defining a retry and fallback hierarchy.
Users must be able to toggle specific notification types

The specification does not clarify if 'Order Status Updates' (transactional) can be disabled. Usually, critical updates are mandatory for operational success. Suggest explicitly defining which notifications are mandatory versus optional.
Ability to handle a high volume of concurrent notifications during peak hours

To ensure scalability, the system should implement priority queuing. Transactional alerts (Order Delivered) should be processed in a separate, higher-priority queue than promotional 'Ad Notifications' to prevent delays during peak load.
Specific alerts for new available orders based on proximity

This requirement raises potential privacy and battery drain concerns regarding constant GPS tracking. Suggest specifying how often proximity is checked and whether the system will respect 'Only while using the app' OS permissions.
